get_osm_data: get OSM map data for a geographic boundary box from the OpenStreetMap API
get_osm_with_cache: get OSM map data for a boundary box and cache the response to a file path
get_osm_overwrite_cache: get OSM map data for a boundary box and overwrite any existing cached file
review_get_osm: review the get_osm function that fetches OpenStreetMap data using a boundary box and optional caching
summarize_get_osm: summarize the get_osm function which queries the OSM API with a bounding box and supports file caching
